name: Ontario Mills
description: Ontario Mills is one of California's largest outlet and value shopping destinations, featuring over 200 stores including premium outlet retailers, entertainment venues, and diverse dining options. This indoor mega-mall combines factory outlets from top brands with entertainment attractions like a 30-screen movie theater and Dave & Buster's, making it a premier destination for Southern California shoppers.
summary: Southern California's premier outlet and entertainment destination with over 200 stores spanning 1.6 million square feet of shopping, dining, and family attractions.
